summary: Strong unit test suite with 47 tests covering all svb_* functions, error paths, and edge cases (prerelease versions, scoped commits, breaking-change markers). Workflow structure tests validate YAML and actionlint. Integration tests via act cover three bump scenarios (minor/patch/major). Weaknesses: only 3 integration test cases run through act (missing multi-commit scenarios, changelog accumulation, mixed commit types); unit/structure tests run directly via bats rather than through act per requirements; missing edge cases (whitespace handling, Windows line endings, multiple BREAKING CHANGEs, git-log-empty fallback); test-fixture files (.actrc, workflow YAML, wf_query.py) not shown but referenced. Well-organized with proper fixtures, setup/teardown, and clear test names; good separation of concerns (unit/structure/integration). Would catch most regressions but gaps remain in edge cases and constraint compliance.
